hero_facts: Online store mifarsoul.com opened July 2026; ships to the US and Canada, free shipping over $65
Every capsule product is $36 (Super Drop Sunshell, Super Fluid Sunshell, Super Cica Hand Cream, Super Vita CC Cream, Super Retinol Eye Cream, Super Collagen Shot Cream); Super Duo serum mists $38
Super Fluid Sunshell: SPF50+ PA++++, no white cast, water resistant, oil-absorbing (store + booth sign)
Soothing Gel Pad: oval pad the brand calls the world's first oval-shaped pad, 100% Tencel, long-lasting hydration, after-sun recovery (booth sign)
Collagen Spicule Pad: micro-spicule delivery system, patented fabric, superior adhesion, collagen firming care (booth sign)
Signs read 'PRIVATE LABEL · alllion': the maker is ALLLION Company Co., Ltd., a Seoul cosmetics OEM/ODM listed on Alibaba
good_for: gift-able, travel-size SPF in a shell
after-sun soothing with a full-face pad
skip_if: you want a brand with a long review history (store is 3 months old)
you need Olive Young availability (not listed there)
products.how_to_use: Pads: open the shell, lift a pad with the tweezers, lay it over the face. Sunshell: twist open the shell and apply like a regular sunscreen.
products.why_viral: Capsule-shell packaging reads instantly on camera, and the oval face-shaped pad is a 'wait, what?' visual.
caveats: Pads (Soothing Gel, Collagen Spicule, Cleansing Finger) are booth previews: not in the online store yet
